pNone_chapter_1: In a dimly lit, high-ceilinged room filled with stacks of books and wooden furniture, Ajit stands by a heavy teak door he has just opened. A middle-aged man in a traditional coat stands in the hallway, illuminated by the warm glow of an electric bulb from within the apartment. The setting reflects a classic 1930s Calcutta interior with shuttered windows and patterned floor tiles. Ajit, dressed in a crisp white dhoti-kurta, holds a magazine in one hand as he looks at his unexpected visitor with a curious expression. The evening atmosphere is quiet and still, with long shadows stretching across the room.
